findings.label: Hardcoded compradorId: 1
findings.description: enviarSolicitud() passes compradorId: 1 unconditionally. Every solicitud is attributed to user 1 regardless of who is signed in. Replace with a real user ID from an auth service or guard the form behind a login check.

findings.label: Stale product list in ProductorPerfil
findings.description: productosDelProductor is populated once in ngOnInit from a snapshot of productosService.productos(). If the signal updates after navigation the profile grid won't reflect it. Convert to a computed() that reads productosService.productos() reactively.

findings.label: productorDelProducto plain getter re-executes every CD cycle
findings.description: The productorDelProducto getter on ProductoDetalle is not memoized. Harmless with a static mock array, but should become a computed() before PRODUCTORES_MOCK is replaced with a service call.
